_meta.status: draft for Nasim to check, then move to data/
_meta.phone_rule: Phones only from the DGHS Facility Registry (hrm.dghs.gov.bd, official MoHFW site). Community clinic phones deliberately left null: the registry lists personal-looking mobiles for CHCPs, and CCs are never referral targets.
_meta.coord_rule: Referral facilities use OpenStreetMap coordinates. DGHS registry coordinates are low-precision or in a mixed format (see notes). CC coordinates are DGHS registry values read as degrees + decimal minutes; each converted point was checked to fall inside the union the registry gives for that clinic (OSM union boundary, point-in-polygon).
_meta.extra_fields: name_bn, dghs_registry_id, dghs_code, phone_alt, notes are additions to the CW2 schema. Safe to ignore.

facilities.name: Nazirpur Upazila Health Complex
facilities.admits_source: DGHS directive: separate dengue wards in all government hospitals (news report, see 02 §3 #10)
facilities.notes: OSM names it 'Nazirpur Govt. Hospital' (addr:place Nazirpur Sadar Union); official name from DGHS registry. DGHS registry lat/lon 22.42, 89.58 read as 22°42', 89°58' = 22.700, 89.967, about 1 km from the OSM point, so consistent. Registry: 50 approved beds, 40 current, last updated 2026-09-28. Registry 'Official Contact No' = 01701248388 (same DGHS 01701248xxx series as other facilities); 'Facility Mobile Number' = 01730324435. Land line 02478891674. Nasim to choose which to show.

facilities.name: Pirojpur District Hospital
facilities.admits_source: DGHS directive: separate dengue wards in all government hospitals (news report, see 02 §3 #10)
facilities.notes: Exact official name per DGHS registry: 'Pirojpur District Hospital' (type District/General Hospital). Also called Pirojpur Sadar Hospital locally; OSM spells it 'Pirozpur General Hospital'. Registry address: Sadar Road, Pirojpur, Pirojpur Paurasava ward 7. Registry lat/lon 22.643799, 89.981353 falls in Durgapur Union, north of town, which does not match the Sadar Road address, so the OSM town-centre point is used. A new 250-bed building reportedly opened in part in August 2026 (news, not verified); its exact location may differ from this point. Land line 02478890444.
